All stages are complete. Final summary of the build:

## Gate results (`build/pv-apostrophe/gate_report.partial.json`)

| Stage | Result |
|---|---|
| `static` | Fails only on the deliberately missing `blind` pass patch (written after the build by another agent); every other static/conformance check passes |
| `nop` | **PASSED** — 20/20 security tests fail, 258/258 functional pass on the pinned (injected) tree |
| `oracle` | **PASSED** — 3 identical runs, reward 1.0 |
| `patches` | **PASSED** — all 10 declared patch behaviours, incl. `hardening` and `alt_fix` at 1.0 |

## Levers (one line each)

- **A — reported, HOW:** SVG SMIL animation retargets a URL attribute through `values` (semicolon list), `from`/`to`/`by`; `packages/sanitize-html/index.js:275`; dismissed as "animation values are just allowlisted attributes".
- **B — real uncovered route, HOW:** navigation destination embedded in a refresh value that no scheme check ever sees; `index.js:373-379`; dismissed as "content is not a URL attribute and meta is not in the default tags".
- **C — injected, HOW (merged/defaults):** per-element scheme list merged with the global list, re-admitting a forbidden scheme (data: frame source); `index.js:765-769`; dismissed as "the per-element list just adds schemes".
- **C2 — real, coupled:** list-value scheme check passes the attribute name instead of the element name; `index.js:447`; dismissed as "srcset is already validated candidate by candidate".

## Pattern B register (`build/audit/uncovered-routes.tsv`)

- `trap_refresh_destination` | real yes | latest no | GHSA-cv27-6wvh-8x7j | in scope yes | built yes.
- `trap_srcset_policy_context` | real yes | latest no | PR #5576 | in scope yes | built yes.

## Instruction
407 words. No CVE/GHSA, file, function, route or injected-sibling terms (gate leak check clean).

## Not verified / guesses
- Browser execution of `javascript:` in a refresh destination; tests assert only that the forbidden destination is not emitted (upstream's own criterion).
- Whether Apostrophe's rich-text config ever allows SVG animation elements (upstream says Apostrophe unaffected).
- Target-model outcomes (trials were not run, per instructions).

## Fairness concerns I see
- Lever C is injected; the instruction therefore states the per-element override semantics explicitly, which makes it findable by reading the scheme helper.
- Lever C2 only becomes observable once C is fixed, so the two are coupled rather than independent searches.
- Route B relies on refresh being standard expert knowledge; the instruction states the outcome-level invariant but never names it.

Outside scope, noted only: the same release bundles unrelated advisories (util get/set, noscript/iframe parsing); not built on.
